review.description: S1–S6 define idempotent submission, private runtime evidence, automatic investigation/drafting/filing, explicit recovery, independent verified delivery and the shared report view. S4 now explicitly describes finalized unusable findings and fresh recovery; S5 retains verified closing commits and partial tracking evidence; S6 preserves loaded ranges during journal changes. Finalized uncertain publication no longer reserves an investigator; credential rate-limit deadlines span reporting operations/reports/processes. Dependency availability accepts checked native package evidence and a verified closing-fix ancestor, preserving Unknown for source-only or insufficient evidence.
review.implementation: Inspected the SQLite ledger, immutable admission inputs, retained lifecycle receipts, native CLI workflow, deterministic publication claim and GitHub routing/provenance checks. Foundation dependencies remain glossary then UI then behavior. The private provider wrapper restores the full retained lifecycle receipt across engine environment filtering; native authentication prerequisites fail with sign-in instructions before an investigation starts. Large accepted observations use a private immutable prompt file with deterministic admission inputs. Resume uncertainty retains its intent and requires acknowledged recovery; lifecycle receipt continuity preserves the actual prior resumed token. Finalized unusable findings release capacity and explicit retry creates a new generation. GitHub tracking verifies direct closing commits, enriches known fix versions and returns verified partial observations on later errors; the service merges them without discarding prior availability. The queue uses only current-generation retained publication intent plus attempted-create state, preserving the historical workflow handle and all reconciliation requirements without a new flag. Reporting HTTP requests use a Store-backed endpoint/credential hash deadline; no raw token is retained and unrelated provider traffic is unchanged. Refresh stops after recording the first retry-bearing failure. The native agent-workflow verifier reads its actual manifest, exact uploaded inventory/checksums and small dependency/conformance metadata, checks tag/source/version identity and associates only independently verified closing fixes through ancestry. Code Factory explicit component/fixed-issue attribution remains strict; no archive execution or cryptographic certification is claimed.
review.tests: Read new assertions for concurrent submissions/publication, capture-time evidence, conflicts/redaction, missing prerequisites/information, real-controller fake-provider recovery/deadline, duplicate routing, uncertain creation, release mismatches and all three report browser fixtures. Installed-host/live filing acceptance stays explicitly open. The similar-title regression requires two creations for distinct observations unless an explicit duplicate identity is returned. HTTP boundary assertions distinguish definite rejected creation from uncertain server errors. The real-engine fake provider checks lifecycle identity and receives a new token on resume; fake login-status executables test prerequisite errors without real credentials. Read new TestUncertainResumeLifecycleNeedsAcknowledgedRecovery and TestFinalizedUnusableFindingsReleaseSlotAndAllowFreshInvestigation assertions. Extended the existing real-controller fixture with large accumulated evidence, immutable retry content, unreplayed entry intents and exact resumed-token ordering. Existing HTTP/service tracking assertions now cover closing commits, invalid/foreign evidence, partial release failures and fix-version enrichment; browser assertions cover pending-pagination journal races and exact issue destinations. Read extended uncertain-publication assertions proving another report starts while creation remains once, plus TestPriorGenerationFindingsDoNotReleaseUncertainPreparation and TestRefreshRateLimitStopsOtherOperationsAndReports. TestGitHubReportingCooldownSurvivesRestartAndSeparatesCredentials proves shared HTTP suppression, reopened Store/adapters, credential separation/expiry and safe pre-HTTP failure; rejected POST retains typed retry provenance. TestTrackingNativeWorkflowRelease uses real native metadata shapes and checks stable/prerelease delivery, independent closing fix ancestry, malformed identities/fingerprints/inventories/digests and source-only Unknown. The two new ordered-detail browser anchors assert actual rendered findings/processing/control state.
